documents.population: International applicants applying directly to ANU for undergraduate programs (including the Bachelor of Advanced Computing (Honours)); applicants with Australian Year 12, the IB Diploma or NCEA apply through UAC International instead
documents.notes: ANU 'Documentation requirements' page (international undergraduate & postgraduate) and the international applications page. A standing policy page; no year is printed on the document list (the applications page lists Semester 1, 2027 key dates). Also on the page: 'Any other required documentation for your preferred program' (program-specific additional requirements, none named for computing); applicants admitted on predicted results (IB, HKDSE, GCE-A, Semester 2 only) must provide the official final academic transcript before enrolment; documents must be scanned in colour and not re-sized. The postgraduate-only items (CV, referees, degree certificate) are not drafted. In earlier rounds study.anu.edu.au's robots.txt was unreachable from the container; on this read it was reachable and allowed the pages.

items.quote: Submit your application through our online application portal. Simply search for your preferred program in the below list, and click on Apply.
Documents you will need to apply to ANU Proof that you have met the University's minimum English language requirements.

Your academic records, including a grading scale. If you are applying for an undergraduate program, you will need to provide an academic transcript that shows that you have completed your secondary studies.

You can choose to provide official ID when you apply (birth certificate, citizenship documents, passport). Official ID will be required if your application is successful and you are offered a place at ANU.
items.condition: if the application is successful and the applicant is offered a place (optional at application); official ID may be a birth certificate, citizenship documents or a passport
